接下来自己试试。营业时留意火候，并按订单添加配料。: Now try it yourself. Watch the heat and follow each order.
把右侧碗里的面糊拖到中间饼炉。: Drag batter from the bowl on the right onto the griddle.
按住左键在面糊上划动，用刮板摊成一张饼。: Hold left mouse and move across the batter to spread it.
点击右侧鸡蛋，把蛋打到饼上。: Click an egg on the right to add it.
等第一面成熟。教学时会停在合适的火候。: Wait for the first side. The lesson pauses the heat when it is ready.
点击“翻面”（或按 F），煎熟另一面。: Click Flip (or press F) to cook the other side.
等第二面成熟，再刷酱。: Wait for the second side, then brush on sauce.
点击右侧酱碗拿刷子，在煎饼上刷酱。: Click the sauce bowl on the right, then brush the jianbing.
刷至正常酱量，再短按右键收刷（或按 F）。: Brush to the normal amount, then tap right mouse (or F) to finish.
基础煎饼不用额外配料。点击“折叠”（或按 F）。: No extra toppings for this order. Click Fold (or press F).
点击“装袋”（或按 F），把煎饼装好。: Click Bag (or press F) to pack it.
把装袋的煎饼拖给上方顾客。: Drag the bagged jianbing to the customer above.
